status: bounded catalog-derived index investigation; no application change
probeSource:
import * as arrays from "std/array"
import * as effects from "std/effect"
import * as inputs from "std/stdin"
import * as json from "std/json"
import { decodeRenderRequest } from "./model/render-request"
import { En, Ja, Locale, translate, localeCode, localizedRoute } from "./model/locale"
import { PageDefinition, SiteCatalog } from "./model/page"
import { catalog } from "./navigation/catalog"

struct Entry deriving JsonEncode {
  id: String,
  locale: String,
  route: String,
  title: String,
  summary: String
}

type ProbeError deriving Show =
  | InputFailure
  | DecodeFailure
  | ConsoleFailure ConsoleError

fn requireInput value: Maybe<String> -> Either<ProbeError, String> = match value {
  Nothing -> Left InputFailure
  Just encoded -> Right encoded
}

fn entry locale: Locale -> page: PageDefinition -> Entry = Entry {
  id: page.id,
  locale: localeCode locale,
  route: localizedRoute locale page.path,
  title: translate locale page.title,
  summary: translate locale page.summary
}

fn index site: SiteCatalog -> Array<Entry> = arrays.concat [
  [entry En page | page <- site.pages],
  [entry Ja page | page <- site.pages]
]

pub effect fn main -> Unit with Console, Stdin fails ProbeError = do {
  limit <- inputs.lineLimit 67108864 |> effects.fromEither |> effects.mapError (\_ -> InputFailure)
  line <- inputs.readLineWith limit |> effects.mapError (\_ -> InputFailure)
  encoded <- requireInput line |> effects.fromEither
  request <- decodeRenderRequest encoded |> effects.fromEither |> effects.mapError (\_ -> DecodeFailure)
  println (json.encodeString (index (catalog request.input))) |> effects.mapError ConsoleFailure
}
limitations: Probe CLI is a local optimized build with older commit metadata, not exact-head CI or an official release archive.
Only page identity, locale, route, title and summary are generated; explicit compiler-owned module/kind fields are still needed for ambiguous symbol results.
No search UI, ranking, browser index loading, keyboard, no-JS fallback, CSP change or publication is implemented.
Two index outputs are compared, not two full site builds; this does not satisfy check:site.
RSS measures fresh process lifetime, not decode/catalog/encoding allocations separately, and does not justify a persistent renderer.
